text:
maria_cs: Hey folks — customer (org: acme-analytics) hit a blocker in nightly jobs after key rotation, embeddings calls OK but generation/rerank return 403. Logs attached below. @ben_eng can you take a look? :eyes:

maria_cs: Error snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","missing":["generation","rerank"]}
``` 

maria_cs: Same key when we call embeddings works: `POST /v1/embeddings 200` — token fingerprint abc123

ben_eng: Thanks. Can you paste the raw Authorization header or key id? Also which provisioning path created this key (SSO, API, console)?

maria_cs: Key id: svc_ak_0abc123def. Provisioned via the new self-serve org onboarding (SSO flow) yesterday ~ 03:10 UTC. No manual edits.

sara_se: Repro steps I ran on a staging replica:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer svc_ak_0abc123def" \
  -d '{"model":"r-infer-small","input":"hi"}'
```
=> 403 same JSON

kevin_infra: Could be the onboarding job that maps SAML groups -> scopes. We recently added a new policy flag `split_infer_scopes` which splits generation vs embedding entitlements. If that mapping failed, token may only have `embeddings`.

ben_eng: If it's the split flag then the token claims should show `scopes:["embeddings"]` only. @maria_cs can you run `jwt decode` on the token (just header+claims) and paste the scopes claim? No private keys.

maria_cs: Pasted claim (redacted): `scopes: ["embeddings","read:org"]`

ben_eng: Confirmed missing `generation`+`rerank`. That's why generate/rerank 403. Two paths: 1) short-term: mint an admin-scoped key to unblock customer, 2) long-term: fix SSO-to-claims mapper to include generation for tenant role `platform-devs`.

eng-oncall: I'm on it. Assigning eta 2h to triage mapping code and check recent deploys that introduced `split_infer_scopes`. Please send tenant id and sample request id from customer.

maria_cs: Tenant id acme-analytics-44, request id req_20260317_0912 (from customer's logs). Sending via support ticket now.

deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-auth v2.4.7 -> production @ 2026-03-17T03:05:22Z

kevin_infra: That deploy lines up with onset. I'll rollback the mapping change in staging and run a repro. If rollback safe, we'll patch prod mapping.

ben_eng: For the immediate unblock, create a scoped key with `scopes:["generation","embeddings","rerank"]` and return to customer with rotation instructions.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll issue the admin key and note rotation TTL. Marking this as high-priority in the support ticket. :lock:

sara_se: Adding a unit test to the SSO mapper to assert generation scope presence for `platform-devs` role.

eng-oncall: Keep me updated in-thread. Filing a postmortem if this touches >1 customer.
